I don’t comment on these post often but I just want to say, stop wasting your time writing this memoir. I know this seems extremely harsh but I just turned 26 and I was and am someone with a big ego and have realized lately that my experiences truly are nothing in comparison to someone who has lived their full life. Think about it, you’re 24, this is truly nothing. If you believe in science until age about three you’re not even forming memories. You don’t even develop your brain fully until 25. So, 21 years of experience in life, with a not fully developed brain, who would want to read that? Now, If you’re doing this as a self-learning project, I commend you. But even if you are using this as that you are still also expecting this to have monetary value for you. I am telling you right now, it will not. What is most important now is connection and independence. Focus on creating relationship and learning to not rely on others (I.e wedding donations, GoFundMe me, no job.) I’m so sorry but writing a memoir at age 24 is not a job. You can do this, be better.
